title: DAO origin verification reconstructs instead of retaining exact received transcript bytes
description: spec/05-routing.md requires DAO Origin Signature verification and replay digesting over exact received DAO bytes with no decode/normalize/re-encode. python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_origin.py:extract_unsigned_dao_bytes rebuilds a new DAO from parsed fields/options and validate() computes the signed DAO digest with dao.to_bytes(); DAO.from_bytes does not retain the original wire. Current parsing happens to preserve common encodings, but the security API cannot prove exact-wire provenance, accepts caller-constructed/mutated objects, and will silently canonicalize any present or future parser normalization. Carry an immutable raw DAO envelope/span from bounds-safe parsing through validation and digesting, bind it to the parsed object, and add noncanonical/mutation/exact-retransmission tests.
